title: The AI Risk Repository: A Comprehensive Meta-Review, Database, and Taxonomy of Risks from Artificial Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review and framework synthesis to extract, categorize, and quantify mentions of racial discrimination and unequal performance from existing AI risk taxonomies into a unified AI Risk Repository.

Systematic literature review and framework synthesis to extract, categorize, and quantify mentions of gender-based discrimination and unequal performance from existing AI risk taxonomies into a unified AI Risk Repository.
Systematic literature review and framework synthesis to extract, categorize, and quantify mentions of unequal model performance affecting people with disabilities from existing AI risk taxonomies.

Systematic literature review and framework synthesis to extract, categorize, and quantify mentions of unequal model performance and unfair discrimination based on social status from existing AI risk taxonomies.

Systematic literature review and framework synthesis to extract, categorize, and quantify mentions of unequal model performance and misrepresentation based on ethnicity from existing AI risk taxonomies.
Systematic literature review and framework synthesis to extract, categorize, and quantify mentions of unequal model performance across different languages from existing AI risk taxonomies.
